summary: Constitutional challenge to sub-classification of Scheduled Castes for reservation; validity under Articles 14, 15, 16; deeming fiction in Article 341 examined; historical evidence of inter-se backwardness; criteria for sub-classification; constitutional bench analysis of precedent; judicial review scope; sub-classification held constitutionally permissible provided rational basis exists.
final_judgment: Constitutional bench upheld validity of sub-classification of Scheduled Castes within reservation framework based on empirical backwardness and inadequate representation.
